keyVerseDR: "...he that received the seed upon good ground, is he that heareth the word, and understandeth, and beareth fruit..." (Mt 13:23)

level1.title: The Sower
level1.story: A farmer scattered seeds. Some fell on the path, on rocks, and in thorns. Some fell on good soil and grew big!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Where did the seeds grow best?
How can your heart be good soil?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help Your word grow in me. Amen.

activity.title: Plant a seed
activity.intro: God's word grows in good soil. Care for creation this week!
items: Plant a seed or water a plant

level2.title: The Parable of the Sower
level2.story: Jesus sat in a boat and told the crowd a parable. A sower went out to sow, and some seed fell on the path, where birds ate it. Some fell on rocky ground and dried up, and some fell among thorns, which choked it. But some fell on rich soil and produced grain, a hundred or sixty or thirtyfold. Jesus explained that the seed is God's word, and the good soil is the one who hears it and understands.
level2.keyLine: He that heareth the word, and understandeth, and beareth fruit.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What are the 'thorns' in a kid's life?
How can you help God's word grow in you?
level2.prayer: Lord, make my heart good soil. Amen.

activity.title: Family talk
items: What kind of soil is my heart today?
What 'thorns' choke God's word in our home?
How can we help God's word grow?
